description: CORRECTION-CARRYING. A two-tier acceptance test for qou-pdix route 5, replacing the retired three-part test, plus its validation against known-wrong candidates. Five criteria: D1 algebraic over Q(q); D2 zero locus; D3 pole locus; D4 bar defect; D5 non-circular (structural). The lever is that alpha is ALGEBRAIC and so carries an arithmetic fingerprint: alpha_D = (q-1)(q+1)(q^3-q^2-1)/(2q(q^2+1)) where the cubic is IRREDUCIBLE over Q with real root the supergolden ratio 1.4655712..., |psi| != 1 so not a root of unity — while alpha_C = -Phi_1 Phi_2 Phi_6 /(2u^2) is entirely CYCLOTOMIC. The conventions differ arithmetically in kind. VALIDATED: of seven candidates exactly one (the target) passes, and the decisive row is the near-miss alpha_D + (q-1)^3, which agrees through t^2 and so PASSES the retired test's part 1 while tier 1 REJECTS it. 🛑 CORRECTION of this file's own first draft: the supergolden zero is NOT a rigid independent fingerprint. z_D - 1 = (q^3-q^2-1)/(q^2+1), so psi is exactly where z_D = 1 — immediate from alpha = (z-1)h/2 — and the corpus already carries psi (centered_hecke_variance_positive names it as the z<1 threshold; spectrahedral-phase-collapse as the convention-C Gram degeneracy at u=1/psi). Consequence: EVERY tier-1 criterion is automatic for any candidate of the form c*(z-1)h, so tier 1 pins the constant c and nothing else. It rejects perturbations but CANNOT detect a construction handed (z-1)h/2 — the same circularity that retired the old test. The discriminating power lives entirely in tier 2 (D5 non-circular, D6 fewer than 9 free parameters), which are checks on the DEFINITION and are read, not run.

alpha_C (other convention).note: different convention — must FAIL the D fingerprint

NEAR-MISS: alpha_D + (q-1)^3.note: agrees through t^2 so PASSES the OLD part 1 — must FAIL the new test

NEAR-MISS: alpha_D * (1 + (q-1)^3).note: keeps alpha's zeros, adds spurious ones — must fail D2

scaled: 2*alpha_D.note: right zeros and poles, WRONG bar defect — must fail D4 only

criteria.D1: algebraic over Q(q) — closes the constant-residue holonomy horn
criteria.D2: zero locus with multiplicities — the sharp one; the supergolden root is not reachable by a cyclotomic construction
criteria.D3: pole locus with multiplicities — forces the q^2+1 of the D Markov denominator
criteria.D4: bar defect F(1/q)+F(q) exact — load-bearing, catches 2*alpha_D which passes D2 and D3
criteria.D5: TIER 2 — non-circular: the construction does not take alpha, (z-1)h/2, or the ladder residual as an INPUT. A check on the definition, not the output; cannot be run here.
criteria.D6: TIER 2 — over-determined: fewer than 9 free parameters. A deg-5/deg-3 rational function has 9 free parameters after scaling, so a construction with 9+ tunables hits all of tier 1 by fitting and passing it is worth nothing. A parameter-free construction meeting all nine is over-determined by nine conditions, and that is evidence.

data.correction: This file's first draft presented the supergolden zero as a rigid fingerprint. It is not: z_D - 1 = (q^3-q^2-1)/(q^2+1), so psi is exactly z_D = 1, and the corpus already records psi in two places (centered_hecke_variance_positive, spectrahedral-phase-collapse). The correction forces the two-tier split: tier 1 is necessary but nearly free for z-built candidates.
